meta.name: json-canvas
meta.description: Create and edit JSON Canvas files (.canvas) with nodes, edges, groups, and connections. Use when working with .canvas files, creating visual canvases, mind maps, flowcharts, or when the user mentions Canvas files in Obsidian.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建和编辑 JSON Canvas 文件，构建可视化画布
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Obsidian 中创建和编辑 .canvas 文件
copy.tagline_en: Create and edit JSON Canvas files for visual canvases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create and edit .canvas files in Obsidian

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能创建和编辑 .canvas 文件，里面可放文字框、文件卡片、链接、分组，以及节点间的连线。它按 JSON Canvas 规范生成有效文件，供 Obsidian 等应用打开。
howto.when: 当你处理 .canvas 文件、要求画思维导图或流程图等可视化内容，或提到 Obsidian 的 Canvas 文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个思维导图 .canvas 文件，包含三个节点和两条连线。
say.note: Claude 会生成符合规范的 .canvas 文件。

say.text: 把这个流程描述转成 .canvas 流程图，并自动排好位置。
say.note: Claude 会生成带节点和边布局的流程图。

say.text: 在现有画布上新增一个分组，把三个节点移进去。
say.note: Claude 会修改并保存 .canvas 文件。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can create and edit .canvas files containing text boxes, file cards, links, groups, and connections between nodes. It generates spec-compliant JSON Canvas files for Obsidian and other apps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you work with .canvas files, ask for mind maps, flowcharts, or other visual canvases, or mention Canvas files in Obsidian.

say_en.text: Create a mind-map .canvas file with three nodes and two edges.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a spec-compliant .canvas file.

say_en.text: Turn this process description into a .canvas flowchart with arranged positions.
say_en.note: Claude will create a flowchart with nodes and edges.

say_en.text: Add a group to the existing canvas and move three nodes into it.
say_en.note: Claude will modify and save the .canvas file.
